captions.instagram:
S corp owner paying yourself only distributions? That's the part the IRS looks at.

✔️ If you work in your S corp, the IRS expects reasonable compensation before non-wage distributions.
✔️ What counts as reasonable: your duties and hours, your training and experience, and what comparable businesses pay for similar work.
✔️ The salary runs through payroll with payroll taxes. Distributions come on top.
